name: George the Fallen
guide_text: Hero power in the early/mid game if you have 1 gold leftover (such as turn 3). Your hero power is very useful in the lategame, but you want to focus on building a good comp first. Going Divine Shield + Venom with Murlocs in is a viable backup strategy.
buddy_guide_text: Buddy up when it costs at most 3, and the buddy will give you midgame stabilization (but don't build around it).
